propositions: The plan-review gate lacks a criterion to determine whether a proposed change is actually needed, resulting in FixedBench's 35-65% over-action rate having no counterpart review coverage.
Bug tickets bypass substantive plan review, short-circuiting to bare exempt-PASS with no DET floor or LLM analysis (verified on bug 5886 with REVIEW_RESULT containing zero llm_calls).
A new advisory pass-1 criterion 'necessity' must flag plans that do not demonstrate the change is needed (no reproduction or motivation), accepting well-motivated no-op or docs-test-only outcomes.
Bug tickets must receive a lightweight advisory review tier consisting of the DET floor plus the necessity probe, never blocking a bug.
Both pieces must be registered advisory, auto-monitored by the standing recorder, and available for promotion to blocking only after dogfood validation.
